description: Reject a submitted timesheet period, returning it to the reporter for correction. The period and its time reports revert to Rejected (editable). A rejection comment is required. Use confirm=true to proceed. Requires Manager or Admin/Owner role (Finance is excluded — timesheet approval is PM work, not finance).

comment.description: Rejection reason shown to the reporter. Required so they know what to fix.

confirm.description: Set true to perform the action. Omit or false returns a preview only — nothing is written.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

submission_period_id.description: Id of the submission period to reject (from get_pending_approvals or list_approval_history).

name: reject_timesheet
